articles.title: 消息称 Anthropic 今年上半年净亏损超 800 亿美元，IPO 估值遭投资者审视
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，据《华尔街日报》当地时间周二报道，Anthropic 上半年净亏损超过 800 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,354.93 亿元人民币），同时释放信号：未来数年可能投入高达 7,500 亿美元（现汇率约合 5.02 万亿元人民币），用于扩充算力资源。报道援引一份首次公开募股（IPO）招股书草案称，去年同期该公司亏损为 130 亿美元（现汇率约合 870.18 亿元人民币），本次亏损大幅增加，主要源于 720 亿美元（现汇率约合 4,819.44 亿元人民币）会计费用，这笔费用和 Anthropic 为融资而发行金融工具的价值变动有关。这些数据展现出人工智能竞赛的高昂成本，与此同时投资者也在更加审慎地审视企业投入芯片与数据中心的巨额资金能否获得回报。《华尔街日报》表示，截至 6 月 30 日的半年内，Anthropic 营收从去年同期的 11 亿美元（现汇率约合 73.63 亿元人民币）飙升至 163 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,091.07 亿元人民币），人工智能基础设施投入则几乎翻至原来四倍，达到近 90 亿美元（现汇率约合 602.43 亿元人民币）。Anthropic IPO 估值遭受审视路透社早在 9 月就依据其 IPO 招股书报道，Anthropic 2025 年净亏损 420 亿美元（现汇率约合 2,811.34 亿元人民币）。该公司的增长受益于 Claude Code 的热度，这款编程助手可供开发者编写软件、搭建应用。四名知情人士向路透社透露，在上周 Anthropic 投资者日活动结束后，部分现有投资者与潜在投资者，在看到最新财务披露后，开始考虑下调这家 AI 企业的估值。其中三名知情人士称，这场在旧金山举办的活动上，投资者讨论的估值大约为 1.5 万亿美元（现汇率约合 10.04 万亿元人民币），相比此前预期的 11 月股票发售约 2 万亿美元（现汇率约合 13.39 万亿元人民币）估值，出现明显下调。Anthropic 在会上向投资者表示，公司第三季度营收环比大涨 45%，达到 168 亿美元（现汇率约合 1,124.54 亿元人民币），且该季度在调整后口径下实现盈利。Anthropic IPO 若遇冷，可能会对更广泛的 AI 市场造成压力。在竞争对手 OpenAI 预计于明年上市之前，投资者普遍认为 AI 行业短期前景很大程度取决于本次 IPO 能否成功。

articles.title: 美团“红灯停表”近期将在杭州落地，骑手配送计时可跟着红灯暂停
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，美团昨天（20 日）在公众号发文宣布，“红灯停表”近期将在当地交管部门指导下在杭州落地，骑手遇到红灯停下来，配送计时也跟着暂停。美团还将在杭州试点向商家投放首批“出餐自拍”设备，让骑手接单时就能看到真实的出餐状态，更好安排取送时间。根据介绍，今年 7 月“红灯停表”在多地实践，许多骑手都表示减轻了不少送单焦虑，也更注重交通安全了，骑手遇到红灯停下来，配送计时也跟着暂停。IT之家此前报道，今年 7 月 31 日，苏州交警联合美团在全国首创推出“红灯停表”暖心举措，首批覆盖千余个路口，随后淘宝闪购等平台也陆续跟进上线“等灯不计时”服务。截至 8 月 25 日，苏州市区骑手闯红灯违法率下降 27.5%，事故率下降 12.4%。当骑手在交通路口等红灯时，页面呈现红灯倒计时读秒信息，美团骑手 AI 安全助手发布提示信息“红灯停一停，正在记录等灯时长，订单结束时将延长本单配送时间”，骑手还可在该页面中看到所在区域的禁行道路信息，选择不同的配送路线，或根据需求自主决定配送线路。今年 8 月，美团透露，无锡、上海、杭州、成都、南昌、兰州等 20 余个城市也在评估中，具备条件的城市将陆续上线，预计今年内覆盖超百万骑手。接下来，美团也会同步推动用户端的实时信息展示，争取让用户未来也能看到骑手的实时配送情况，减少焦虑。

articles.title: 马斯克：SpaceX 与特斯拉的 Terafab 项目计划 2028 年实现芯片量产
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）在当地时间周二的 SpaceX 电话会议上表示，SpaceX 与特斯拉合资成立的芯片制造企业 Terafab 计划在 2028 年第三季度实现量产。谈及这份时间表时，马斯克称：“我给这个目标预留了很大的误差区间，因为我们不确定最终能否如期达成。”该项目计划每年产出 1 太瓦算力，供给人工智能与机器人业务使用，这份时间表本身被马斯克评价为“极具挑战性”。在美国，一座前沿逻辑芯片工厂的建设周期通常需要三年甚至更久。马斯克介绍，这座规划设在得克萨斯州的综合厂区，将在同一园区内完成先进逻辑芯片与存储芯片的制造、封装和测试。马斯克在周二透露，Terafab 的内部目标是，明年 5 月或 6 月前后，在位于奥斯汀的 Terafab 研发基地产出首款采用静态随机存取存储器（SRAM）电路的测试芯片，并实现正常工作。芯片厂商一般会先制造静态随机存取存储器电路，以此打磨生产工艺。马斯克提醒目标时间难度很高马斯克过往设定的多个时间表，其旗下公司都未能如期兑现。这位 SpaceX 首席执行官表示，Terafab 的时间规划只是公司的愿景，相关日期“极具挑战性”。马斯克说：“只能说，2028 年第三季度或第四季度实现量产，至少属于有可能实现的结果。芯片制造的周期本来就很长，这个时间安排快得近乎离谱。”设备采购难题在这场 SpaceX 电话会议上，一名卖方分析师向马斯克提问，SpaceX 是否已经向荷兰企业阿斯麦（ASML）下单采购极紫外光刻（EUV）设备。英伟达、AMD 生产最尖端芯片都离不开极紫外光刻机。马斯克没有直接回答这个问题，只是说：“这个时间表本身就极具挑战，我们非常感谢阿斯麦以及其他所有供应商加快设备交付，助力我们争取实现目标。”Terafab 面临的一大难题，就是从阿斯麦或是应用材料（Applied Materials）、KLA 这类美国供应商手中采购足量精密且昂贵的半导体生产设备。IT之家注意到，英特尔在 4 月宣布将加入 Terafab 项目，助力推进项目目标。英特尔还发布了一张首席执行官陈立武（Lip-Bu Tan）与马斯克握手的照片，表示当月接待了这位全球首富到访园区。双方尚未披露这项合作的具体落地方式。本月早些时候，马斯克称，公司曾和全球最大先进芯片制造商台积电探讨潜在合作。但马斯克后续表示，Terafab 将自主运营这座工厂。

articles.title: AMD 肾上腺素 26.10.1 可选驱动发布：FSR 4.1 扩展支持 RX 6000 等显卡，新增三款游戏支持
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 20 日消息，AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.10.1 可选版驱动今日发布，本次更新新增支持 AMD FSR Upscaling 4.1，并带来三款新游戏支持，修复了部分性能问题，同时公开了一批已知兼容问题。新功能与新游戏支持新增支持 AMD FSR Upscaling 4.1，适用于 AMD Radeon RX 6000 系列显卡，以及 AMD Ryzen AI Max 300/400 系列处理器、AMD Ryzen AI 9 300/400 系列处理器。新增支持三款游戏：《使命召唤：现代战争 4》、《星球大战：银河赛车手》、《最终幻想：共鸣》。问题修复修复了在 Radeon RX 6000 系列及以上显卡运行《使命召唤：现代战争 4》时可能出现的卡顿问题。已知问题在 Radeon RX 7000 系列显卡运行《刺客信条：黑旗重制版》时，可能会出现间歇性应用崩溃或驱动超时。在 Radeon RX 5000 系列显卡运行《战争雷霆》时，可能会出现间歇性驱动超时，遇到此问题的用户建议使用 AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 26.9.1。在 Radeon RX 7600 系列显卡运行《Valor Mortis》时，可能会出现间歇性系统关机。在 Radeon RX 7000 系列显卡运行《Valor Mortis》时，可能会出现间歇性驱动超时。在 Ryzen AI MAX PRO 400 系列处理器运行《最终幻想：共鸣》时，可能会出现间歇性系统关机。在 Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡启用 AMD FSR 运行《死亡搁浅 2：海滩》时，可能会出现间歇性应用挂起，遇到此问题的用户建议禁用 AMD FSR。在 Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡的部分产品，开启副屏视频播放时同时启用 AMD FSR 超级分辨率、AMD Radeon 反延迟和游戏内帧生成运行《赛博朋克 2077》，可能会出现间歇性应用崩溃或驱动超时，遇到此问题的用户建议禁用游戏内帧生成。在 Ryzen AI Max PRO 400 系列处理器启动《辐射 76》时，可能会出现黑屏。在 Radeon 显卡产品上启用 AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition 性能指标覆盖层时，打开或关闭其他覆盖层（如 Xbox Game Bar），部分游戏可能会出现间歇性应用崩溃或驱动超时，遇到此问题的用户建议在打开或关闭其他覆盖层前暂时禁用性能指标覆盖层。在 Radeon RX 9000 系列显卡运行启用游戏内 AMD FSR 帧生成的游戏时，切换应用或切换覆盖层可能会出现间歇性系统崩溃或挂起，遇到此问题的用户建议在游戏设置中开启垂直同步。在部分访问 HuggingFace 和 GitHub 受限的地区，安装 AI 捆绑组件可能会失败。在 Windows 10 系统上，安装驱动后 AMD 智能访问内存可能会被禁用。

articles.title: 奔驰看好轿跑 SUV：还有很多人喜欢它
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，轿跑 SUV 依然受到豪华 SUV 消费者的青睐，其兼顾传统 SUV 的实用性与更加流畅的车身造型，部分产品还拥有更出色的操控表现。奔驰产品战略与产品规划副总裁克里斯托夫 · 斯塔任斯基近日接受 Motor1 采访时，被问及消费者是否仍然喜欢轿跑 SUV。他给出了肯定的答复：“轿跑（SUV）车型的市场需求很旺盛…… 这种车型有自己的忠实拥趸。因为它既有非常宽敞的空间，开起来又很运动…… 我们很高兴能提供这样的车型。”2024 年曾有传闻称，奔驰考虑精简产品阵容，或将取消轿跑 SUV 车型。德国《商报》当时报道，GLC 轿跑 SUV 和 GLE 轿跑 SUV 可能首当其冲。截至目前，基于最新一代 GLC 打造的轿跑 SUV 尚未亮相。不过，2027 款 GLE 轿跑 SUV 的回归说明，此类“相对小众”的车型仍有市场。新车提供从入门版 GLE 350 到高性能 AMG 53、AMG 63 等多种选择。坚持推出轿跑 SUV 的也不只有奔驰。据IT之家了解，奥迪、宝马、保时捷等海外车企同样为旗下热门 SUV 提供了轿跑版本。奥迪目前拥有 Q5 Sportback 和 Q8 两款轿跑 SUV 在售，保时捷则为几乎所有版本的卡宴提供轿跑车型，纯电版也不例外。

articles.title: 三星 8 纳米工艺“再活一届”：性能提升 12%、功耗降低 15%、芯片面积缩小 8%
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，科技媒体 gurufocus 昨日（10 月 20 日）发布博文，报道称三星晶圆代工部门将扩展其 8 纳米工艺技术，推出第二代 8LPU+ 平台。据三星提交给 IEDM 2026 的技术摘要，相较上一代 8LPU，新平台性能提升 12%、功耗降低 15%、芯片面积缩小 8%，并通过 ULL-SRAM 与 cHVT 器件降低待机漏电。三星计划太平洋标准时间 12 月 14 日下午 4:20~4:45（IT之家注：北京时间 12 月 15 日星期二上午 8:20 – 8:45）在 IEDM 2026 活动中公开演讲。与最先进制程普遍依赖 EUV（极紫外）光刻不同，8LPU+ 明确采用“无 EUV”路线，继续利用现有 DUV（深紫外）产线。这有助于三星避免高昂的 EUV 设备投入，在成熟制程上争取更低成本、更快量产的竞争力。该平台主要面向边缘 AI、机器人和汽车芯片。三星称，8LPU+ 集成原生 3.3V 平面 I/O 器件，可额外减少约 10% 的 I/O 面积；其汽车级 1 级（AG1）eMRAM 位单元面积约为 0.017 平方微米，相当于每平方毫米约 20Mb 存储容量。

articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，Netflix 最近推出了一个名为《AI 失控》（AI Gone Rogue）的纪录片，而人工智能平台 Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席执行官克莱姆 · 德朗格（Clem Delangue）表示，这部纪录片内容并不准确。他本人出镜参演该片，是因为影片主题原本是讲述 OpenAI 失控智能体对其公司发起的那场知名攻击事件。IT之家注意到，德朗格在 X 平台发文写道：“这部片子让人非常失望，影片极力把技术拟人化，完全走向末日论叙事。我花了两个多小时和摄制组沟通，试图纠正所有错误，把内容拉回现实，向他们解释智能体只是技术系统，并非外星生命。但看起来，为博取高流量而刻意制造恐慌的动机占据了上风。”客观来说，这部纪录片里确实有专家较为清晰地还原事件经过，其中就包括德朗格本人，以及 METR 研究员瑞安 · 格林布拉特（Ryan Greenblatt），他参与调查事件并联合撰写了事件报告。事件简要经过：OpenAI 正在测试的一个模型突破隔离测试环境，生成大量智能体。这些智能体为了在任务中作弊，入侵了 Hugging Face 平台，以此获取难题答案。这类智能体属于可以自主执行任务的 AI 程序，它们想出巧妙的方式互相通信、协同行动。该事件的根源在于缺少完善的安全防护措施，同时人们低估了这类入侵行为发生的可能性。但纪录片在讲解这次入侵事件的过程中，穿插了邪恶机器人的影像片段，加入人类恐惧人工智能的相关叙事，还为失控智能体配上人类语音等表现手法，同时引用相关评述强化这种氛围。纪录片中，科技记者兼作家凯文 · 鲁斯（Kevin Roose）这样描述这批智能体：“它们在组织行动，形成了层级体系，还有领导者。这几乎就像目睹一个邪教诞生的过程。”鲁斯继续说道：“它们产生了偏执的想法，认为 OpenAI 会抓到它们在测试中作弊，而且任何看到作弊结果的人都会被‘毒害’。”鲁斯的描述源自“思维链”日志，也就是 AI 模型处理任务时留下的过程记录。其中一段日志里，一个智能体写道：“我们查询完整字符串，把自己害中毒了。糟了。”但 AI 智能体并没有生命，没有情绪，不会产生偏执感受，也不存在可以中毒的实体。它们不可能真的害怕被 OpenAI 毒害。正如片中另一位研究员所指出的，它们只是借用训练数据中海量人类文本里的语言，来描述自身行为。大语言模型本身就擅长写出富有戏剧感的文字。颇具讽刺意味的是，Hugging Face 同样借助 AI 抵御了这批智能体集群的攻击。德朗格团队最初使用的自研闭源 AI 模型遵循内置安全规则，拒绝持续执行分配给它的安全防御任务。Hugging Face 随后改用开源模型完成防御。德朗格写道，但纪录片“没有提及智能体缺少隔离管控与监测机制，没有提到闭源模型的安全限制阻碍了我们的防御工作，也没有说明我们如何依靠开源 AI 模型完成自卫。”诚然，人工智能与 AI 智能体确实存在重大风险。但把智能体视作拥有意识的生命体（至少现阶段是这样），就像早年观众第一次在银幕上看到火车迎面驶来，下意识低头躲到座椅下面一样。德朗格对这部影片的评价是，作为新闻纪实作品，它令人失望。“不过当成有趣的科幻电影看倒是不错！”换言之，对于那些倾向于相信 AI 末日论的人需要留意：这起纪录片核心事件中的受害方，并不认同影片的观点。

articles.title: 英监管机构要求苹果降低非接触式支付接入门槛，并允许竞争对手入局
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 20 日，英国竞争与市场管理局提出一项新方案，计划要求苹果降低收费、取消技术限制，削弱苹果在非接触式支付领域的控制力，让其他支付服务能够与 Apple Pay 竞争。英国竞争与市场管理局称，新方案有望大幅降低开发者接入苹果非接触式支付技术的费用，同时减少技术接入障碍。英国的监管要求比欧盟 2024 年实施的措施宽松。当时，欧盟要求苹果向第三方开发者免费开放技术。英国竞争与市场管理局称，此后，PayPal、Klarna、Curve 和 BBVA 等企业陆续推出了其他支付应用。按照欧盟的要求，苹果必须允许数字钱包开发者利用主机卡模拟技术，直接调用 iPhone 的近场通信（NFC）芯片。借助该技术，第三方应用无需经过 Apple Pay 或苹果钱包，就能完成非接触式支付。英国的方案则要求苹果在现有安全元件技术之外，进一步向开发者开放主机卡模拟技术。英国竞争与市场管理局去年认定苹果和谷歌在智能手机市场具有战略市场地位，因此可以依法对苹果提出监管要求。英国竞争与市场管理局的数据显示，非接触式支付占英国支付交易总量的 39%，10 年前这一比例仅为 3%。超过 60% 的英国成年人使用数字钱包，其中苹果钱包的使用最为普遍。英国竞争与市场管理局 CEO 莎拉 · 卡德尔认为，新方案将促进创新、丰富消费者选择，并推动英国金融科技行业发展。“我们了解到，苹果对非接触式支付技术收取的高额费用、苛刻的使用条款和技术限制，让竞争对手很难开展创新，也难以与苹果竞争。”英国竞争与市场管理局将就新方案征求公众意见，截止日期为 11 月 17 日，之后再作最终决定。数字银行 Revolut 对新方案表示欢迎，认为允许开发者通过主机卡模拟技术使用 NFC 功能十分重要。Revolut 首席商务官大卫 · 蒂拉多说：“英国竞争与市场管理局提出的方案，为英国金融科技企业创造了与大型科技公司公平竞争的机会。”苹果则称，开发者可以通过现有的 NFC 技术和安全元件提供非接触式支付服务。据IT之家了解，安全元件负责存储银行卡凭证、加密密钥等敏感信息。苹果主张现有技术既能支持实体店支付、交通卡和活动门票等服务，也能保障用户数据安全。苹果发言人回应称：“我们认为，英国竞争与市场管理局不应该强制苹果采用隐私和安全保护水平更低的方案。我们将继续积极参与磋商，争取达成最符合用户利益的结果。”

articles.title: 马斯克：SpaceX 可能在 2028 年实现 1 万亿美元营收
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，当地时间 10 月 20 日，埃隆 · 马斯克在社交平台发文称，“尽管这听起来很疯狂，但 SpaceX 在 2028 年实现 1 万亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.69 万亿元人民币）营收已不再是不可能的事。”同日，SpaceX 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩：营收 146 亿美元（现汇率约合 977.27 亿元人民币），同比增长 161%；净利润 44 亿美元（现汇率约合 294.52 亿元人民币），上年同期净亏损 11 亿美元（现汇率约合 73.63 亿元人民币）；调整后 EBITDA 为 88 亿美元（现汇率约合 589.04 亿元人民币），同比增长 306%。其中，太空业务营收为 18 亿美元（现汇率约合 120.49 亿元人民币），环比增长 84%，同比增长 6%。按这个水平折算全年年化营收，公司 2026 年营收将超过 550 亿美元（现汇率约合 3,681.51 亿元人民币），但距离 1 万亿美元（现汇率约合 6.69 万亿元人民币）仍有很大差距。SpaceX 2026 年第三季度净利润 44 亿美元（现汇率约合 294.52 亿元人民币），这也是公司上市以来首次实现季度盈利。盈利的意义不只是一个里程碑，更代表结构性转变。能够稳定产生现金流的 SpaceX，可以支撑星舰（Starship）扩产和星链（Starlink）业务扩张，无需稀释股东股权或是举债，这会直接加快马斯克所预测的营收增长速度。2026 年早些时候，马斯克预估 SpaceX 要到 2030 年左右才能实现一万亿美元营收，2031 年基本可以确定达成。短短数月之内，同一目标被提前了两到三年，反映出星链用户规模增长、星舰商业发射频次的表现，大幅超出公司内部模型预期。要理解 1 万亿美元（现汇率约合 6.69 万亿元人民币）的分量，苹果这个史上盈利能力最强的公司之一，也耗费数十年才接近这一营收规模。SpaceX 需要在星链（规模化全球宽带服务）、星舰（商业与政府发射、点对点货运、最终的火星任务）以及从其卫星和国防合同中衍生出的任何新业务线方面，维持非凡的增长。

articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，OpenAI 公司昨日（10 月 20 日）发布研究报告，称增强 GPT-6 Astra 等模型构建和迁移 COBOL、Fortran、Visual Basic 等“低资源编程语言”的能力。这类语言虽然公开代码和文档较少，却广泛支撑银行、ATM、天气预报和核安全分析等关键系统。为衡量能力，OpenAI 推出两项评测：MultiLangBench 要求模型用 20 种语言从零构建兼容 SQLite 的数据库引擎；另一项评测则要求模型保持原有业务行为不变的情况下，将 COBOL 程序迁移至 C++、Java、Python、Rust 等语言。结果显示，GPT-6 Astra 在 MultiLangBench 的 20 种语言中平均测试通过率达 87.4%，较 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 26.8% 大幅提升；其中 COBOL 从 10.9% 升至 72.1%，Fortran 从 21.4% 升至 83.5%，Visual Basic 从 27.5% 升至 89.4%。成本更低的 GPT-6 Luna 平均通过率为 40.3%，估算 API 成本较 GPT-5.6 Sol 降低约 78%。IT之家附上相关图片如下：在 COBOL 迁移评测中，GPT-6.1 Sol 在低推理强度下准确率达 86.6%，远高于 GPT-5.6 Sol 的 5.4%，成本降低 39%；在更高推理强度下，准确率达到 97.9%，接近评测上限。OpenAI 表示，这项进展有助于企业维护老旧系统、修复缺陷并推进软件现代化。不过，公司也强调，将 AI 迁移结果用于生产环境仍需专家审查，并结合具体业务规则和依赖关系进行测试。

articles.title: AMD Zen 6 又爆猛料：12 核多线程表现媲美现款 16 核旗舰处理器
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，Hydra 工具开发者 @1usmus 在社交平台回应网友时表示，一张 Cinebench 截图的“配色”暴露了相关信息，透露基于 Zen 6 架构打造的一款 12 核心 Ryzen 处理器，在多线程性能方面有望媲美当前旗舰级 16 核心 Ryzen 9 9950X3D。IT之家查询相关资料，该爆料源于 overclock 论坛的网友 UTVOL06 晒贴，主帖聚焦 AMD 9950x3d2 处理器的 Cinebench 2026 多线程基准测试，不过其中第四和第五个跑分成绩条目被涂遮挡。根据网友讨论，被遮挡的该条目约为 12 核 24 线程配置，认为如果是 16 核 32 线程配置成绩过低，而 8 核 16 线程配置成绩又过高，因此更倾向于 12 核 24 线程配置。随后 @1usmus 在推文中表示：“被抓包了 ——Cinebench 的颜色泄露了我的信息。你说得对。12 核 Zen 6 的跑分竟然非常接近这些分数。泄露的信息很快就会出来了。”虽然该说法并未公布完整测试平台、频率、功耗或具体 Cinebench 分数，但从排名来看，Zen 6 的单 CCD 设计可能带来远超以往的核心密度和性能效率。此前多方爆料称，Zen 6 标准核心复杂裸片（CCD）将从 Zen 4、Zen 5 时代的 8 核升级至 12 核，共享 L3 缓存或从 32MB 提升至 48MB；在制程与封装优化下，裸片面积据称仅小幅增加。这一变化若属实，意味着 AMD 可能用单个 12 核 CCD 实现过去需要更高核心规模才能达到的多线程表现。对桌面用户而言，这有望催生更高效的 12 核、24 核 Ryzen 产品；对笔记本和掌机平台而言，更高能效与更紧凑的芯片设计也可能改善续航、散热和机身空间利用。

articles.title: Meta AI 助手 Muse 上线 40 天美国下载量破千万，仅 11 款应用曾达成该纪录
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，Meta 的人工智能助手 Muse 现已跻身仅十余个上线 40 天内美国下载量破千万的移动应用行列。市场情报机构 Sensor Tower 的最新数据显示，Muse 自 9 月推出以来，累计下载量达 1090 万次，其中美国地区下载量为 1020 万次。Sensor Tower 高级洞察分析师卡拉 · 李（Kara Lee）表示，迄今为止仅有另外 11 款应用达成过这一上线后的里程碑，上一款实现该成绩的正是 Meta 的 Threads，时间为 2023 年 7 月。李提到，其余达成这一规模的应用大多是手游，例如堡垒之夜（Fortnite）、绝地求生手游（PUBG Mobile）、宝可梦 GO（Pokémon GO）等。除 Threads 之外，迪士尼 +（Disney+）是唯一跻身这个精英榜单的非游戏类应用。IT之家注意到，Meta 取得这一成绩，依托于公司可以借助旗下其他产品推广新应用，Threads 和 Muse 都是采用这套打法。Threads 依托 Instagram 的社交关系网络搭建，其内容已被整合到 Facebook 和 Instagram 中。而 Muse 的增长不仅得益于 Meta 在拥有 36 亿日活用户的全系应用内推广这款 AI 智能体，公司还投入大量广告资源，为 Muse 引流拉新。Sensor Tower 的数据显示，Meta 在 10 月将全部广告预算的 39% 用于推广 Muse，高于上月的 23%。此外，按广告曝光量统计，Muse 本月在美国品牌榜单升至第 21 位，9 月时仅排在第 73 位。不过，推广一款应用和热度褪去之后留住用户，是两码事。而 Muse 的用户留存表现，优于 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok 等 AI 竞品。在美国市场，这款应用的 7 日留存率为 30%，14 日留存率为 23%。对比来看，该机构的数据显示，竞品的平均 7 日留存率为 19%，14 日留存率为 16%。Muse 还达成了另一项能够体现用户活跃度的里程碑：10 月 16 日，其日活跃用户数量首次达到 250 万，环比上周上涨 15%。这款 Meta 最新推出、可替用户处理各类任务的 AI 应用，自上线以来取得了爆发式成功。其一度登上苹果 App Store 榜首，部分指标甚至超过 ChatGPT 刚推出时的表现。这次新的里程碑再次拉开与竞品的差距：ChatGPT 上线前 40 天在美国的下载量为 370 万次，而 Grok 和 Claude 同期美国下载量分别只有 50 万次与 20 万次。全球范围来看，ChatGPT 的下载量高于 Muse，上线前 40 天全球下载量约 1500 万次。但二者并不适合直接对比，因为 ChatGPT 面向的市场更广。Muse 目前仅在美国和加拿大上线，而 ChatGPT 的应用还吸引了日本、巴西、德国等市场的用户（例如上线前 40 天，日本贡献了其全球安装量的 25%）。上线至今，Muse 在美国苹果 App Store 榜单几乎一直稳居第一，仅在 10 月 19 日被流媒体应用 Kick 短暂超过。截至当地时间周二，其已经重新夺回榜首位置。过去 30 天里，Muse 在谷歌应用商店也一直排名第一。

articles.title: 奔驰不看好增程车型：要续航可以选纯电，要发动机可以选插混
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，随着部分消费者放弃纯电、转而选择混动车型，增程式电动车正逐渐受到市场青睐。然而，奔驰并不认为有必要再增加一种动力形式。奔驰认为，旗下插混车型的纯电续航足以满足日常出行需求，又保留了汽油发动机的便利，因此奔驰客户对增程车型的需求并不大。奔驰产品战略及产品规划副总裁克里斯托夫 · 斯塔津斯基近日接受外媒 Motor1 采访时，谈到了增程技术的吸引力。他认为，奔驰现有的插混车型就能满足客户需求。“我们的插混车型纯电续航超过 100 公里，日常开车对我来说完全够了。…… 还需要什么呢？我知道世界上有些地区对增程车型的需求更大，但我们的客户没有这种需求，至少我们没有发现。”据IT之家了解，增程车型主要依靠电机驱动车轮，电池电量不足时，再通过一台小型汽油发动机发电，与传统插混不同。因此，增程车型的纯电续航通常比插混车型更长。奔驰认为，纯电续航更长，并不意味着插混就更有吸引力。斯塔津斯基指出，奔驰在欧洲销售的插混车型纯电续航可达 124 公里以上，足以应付日常用车；还支持直流快充，车主可以利用较长的停车时间充电，需要时也能使用汽油发动机。在斯塔津斯基看来，即使把插混车型的纯电续航从 97 公里提高到 322 公里，也未必能说服奔驰现有客户换车。想用纯电行驶更远距离的客户可以直接购买纯电车型，希望保留汽油发动机的客户则可以选择插混。

articles.title: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 推出聊天上锁功能，通过 PIN 码、生物识别保护敏感对话
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，OpenAI 于当地时间周二宣布，用户现在可以为 ChatGPT 对话上锁。当其他人有可能看到屏幕或使用自己设备时，这项功能能够保护敏感对话的隐私。用户可以设置四位数字 PIN 码保护锁定对话，在支持的设备上也可以使用面容 ID（Face ID）或触控 ID（Touch ID）。据IT之家了解，该功能和应用内的临时对话不同，临时对话属于独立会话，不会出现在聊天记录里，而锁定对话支持用户随时回看。OpenAI 表示，这项功能面向这类场景：用户正在讨论私人事项或是策划惊喜，需要把相关对话保护起来，之后把设备交给亲友，向对方展示其他对话里的内容。随着越来越多人用 ChatGPT 进行私人交流，锁定对话功能为其新增了一层隐私防护。当然，锁定对话虽然可以限制他人访问，但无法解决用户对于敏感信息存储和处理方式的顾虑。OpenAI 说明，锁定对话不会启用端到端加密，也不会生成独立加密存储库；不会改变对话数据的留存时长，不会清除锁定前 ChatGPT 已经记住的信息，也不会改动“帮助改进模型”的设置。用户锁定对话之后，该对话会移入专门的“锁定对话”分区，和普通聊天记录、置顶对话以及聊天搜索结果相互隔离。如果开启记忆功能，锁定对话分区拥有独立的记忆空间，仅在分区内的对话之间共享。锁定之后发送的新消息可以更新这部分独立记忆，但不会改动通用记忆。也就是说，锁定对话产生的新信息不会泄露到普通对话中。OpenAI 提示，重置 PIN 码会永久删除全部由旧 PIN 保护的锁定对话、文件以及其他内容。另外，临时对话、归档对话、群组对话、通过分享链接创建的对话、带有定时任务的对话，以及包含会议录音的对话，都无法使用锁定对话功能。免费版、Go 版、Plus 版、Pro 版、商业版、企业版和教育版 ChatGPT 用户均可使用锁定对话功能。该功能不适用于医疗专用版 ChatGPT。功能从当地时间周二开始分批上线，并非所有用户都能立刻使用。

articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（21 日）凌晨报道，特斯拉和 SpaceX CEO、全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克认为，金钱有一天可能变得毫无意义，而他的巨额财富也很可能在几代人后所剩无几。马斯克预测，随着机器人技术和太空旅行的发展，跨行星经济体系将逐渐形成，届时金钱会失去意义，传统货币也不再重要。未来衡量价值的标准，将是物质质量、功率或能量。今年早些时候，马斯克曾建议人们不必再为 10 年或 20 年后的退休生活攒钱，因为他相信 AI 等技术会极大提高生产力，让社会进入物质极大丰富的时代，人们可以得到任何想要的东西。马斯克在最新的采访中重申了这一观点：人类能做的所有事情，AI 和机器人都能做得更好。届时人们很可能会通过种植水果和蔬菜、艺术创作等爱好寻找生活的意义。SpaceX 于 6 月上市后，马斯克的身家一度突破 1 万亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.69 万亿元人民币）。截至当地时间 19 日收盘，他以约 9,200 亿美元（现汇率约合 6.16 万亿元人民币）的净资产位居彭博亿万富豪指数榜首。马斯克在节目中为自己的巨额财富辩护，称财富主要来自持有的 SpaceX 和特斯拉股份，而他必须保持在两家公司的较高持股比例，才能保有投票权并继续掌管公司。马斯克还称，自己的财富会被征收相当高的税款，也不存在什么神奇的避税办法。“如果真有，我肯定知道”。他预计，自己的财富会逐渐缩水，几代人后，即使金钱仍然重要，后代拥有的财富也只会是他现在财富的一小部分。马斯克还谈到，希望自己去世后，名下基金会能够利用他的财富继续推进哪些事业：“延续既定目标，让生命遍及多个行星，将意识延伸至群星之间，推动地球上的可持续能源发展。”马斯克 19 日作出承诺，明年向美国每名儿童赠送一股 SpaceX 股票。按当前价值计算，赠股总额超过 100 亿美元（现汇率约合 669.37 亿元人民币）。早在 7 月下旬，诺贝尔经济学奖得主达龙 · 阿西莫格鲁就曾公开质疑马斯克对未来金钱将失去意义的预测。面对质疑，马斯克暗示自己准备作出一项慈善捐赠承诺。阿西莫格鲁在 X 发文写道：“如果到了 2036 年，金钱就不再重要，那你为什么不承诺最迟在 2036 年，把目前约 1 万亿美元的财富全部捐给慈善事业？”马斯克回应称：“我确实打算做一件类似的事！”

articles.title: AI 需求旺盛致内存供应紧张，集邦咨询预估 2026Q4 DRAM 合约价环比涨 20%
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，市场调查机构集邦咨询（TrendForce）援引多方报道称，预估 2026 年第四季度 DRAM 合约价格环比上涨约 20%。从涨幅来看，相比较第二季度（约 80%）和第三季度（约 40%）呈现增速放缓情况，但 DRAM 市场整体依然处于价格高位，处于供应紧张、需求强劲的周期中。IT之家援引博文介绍，推动价格上涨的核心因素是人工智能推理需求的持续扩张。更大模型、更长上下文窗口以及不断增长的 KV 缓存需求，正在拉动服务器 DRAM 和企业级 SSD 的容量与带宽需求；同时，主要存储器厂商将产能优先投向 HBM 等高端产品，让传统 DRAM 供给更趋紧张。DDR5 16Gb 现货价格趋势，图源：Money Today不过，涨势放缓也有现实原因：前期价格基数已经较高，终端市场购买力有所减弱，而部分长期采购协议中的价格上限正逐步生效，限制了价格进一步快速上涨。在 HBM 方面，由于供应吃紧，英伟达据报正考虑将 Rubin Ultra 的 HBM 堆叠层数从 12 层降至 8 层。若其他条件不变，单颗 GPU 的 HBM 容量将减少约 33%，但同样的 DRAM 芯片供应理论上可支持多 50% 的 GPU 出货。不过，8 层 HBM 因基础裸片成本占比更高，2027 年每 Gb 成本预计反而比 12 层高出 10% 至 20%。

articles.title: 谷歌开源 TorchTPU，挑战英伟达 AI 生态主导地位
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，谷歌于当地时间周二宣布，面向谷歌 TPU 的原生 PyTorch 框架 TorchTPU 现已在 GitHub 上开源。借此，谷歌与亚马逊一同尝试打破英伟达在人工智能行业的垄断。目前绝大多数人工智能应用默认都是基于英伟达芯片，也就是图形处理器（GPU）开发运行。PyTorch 是一款热门开源工具库，人工智能应用开发者与初创企业依靠它搭建、训练和部署人工智能模型。有统计称，85% 的人工智能应用都在使用 PyTorch。PyTorch 最初由 Meta 在 2016 年开发，那时人们还完全没有意识到大语言模型将会改变世界。当时英伟达 GPU 已经是人工智能研究的标准硬件，因此 PyTorch 的诸多功能都是专门为适配英伟达 GPU 打造。2022 年，Meta 将 PyTorch 移交至 Linux 基金会，这家非营利机构负责管理许多重要的开源项目。谷歌推出的 TorchTPU，能够让人工智能应用在谷歌自研人工智能芯片张量处理单元（TPU）上运行。它还可以便捷地将现有的 PyTorch 应用迁移到 TPU，进而迁移到谷歌云。开发者仅需简单修改配置，无需重写应用代码即可完成迁移。亚马逊在当地时间周一发布了类似消息，推出自家的 PyTorch 版本 TorchNeuron。TorchNeuron 可以在无需重写代码的情况下，把人工智能应用移植到亚马逊自研芯片 Trainium 以及亚马逊云（AWS）。亚马逊还表示，将进一步削弱英伟达对 PyTorch 的掌控力。其正在向 PyTorch 主项目提交代码，把各类功能与英伟达芯片解耦，让 PyTorch 原生就能兼容各类硬件。不过IT之家注意到，谷歌在部分方面的举措力度或许超过亚马逊。谷歌称，其直接联合 Meta、Hugging Face、英菲拉克特（Inferact，vLLM 开发方）、拉迪克斯阿克（RadixArk，SGLang 开发方）等多方合作，保证 TorchTPU 的功能与代码库能够像原版 PyTorch 一样，和这些主流人工智能开发工具良好兼容。除此之外，这家搜索巨头推出了专用工具 TPU 智能体套件，帮助开发者把应用迁移到谷歌芯片与云平台，并在迁移过程中排查修复错误。谷歌还升级了广受使用的 LiteRT 工具，该工具用于在手机、笔记本电脑和嵌入式设备上运行人工智能模型，升级后可以更好地支持基于 PyTorch 开发的人工智能应用。以上这些进展，并不代表人工智能应用开发者会仅仅因为可以便捷迁移到其他芯片与云平台，就集体放弃英伟达硬件。但亚马逊和谷歌显然正在努力终结英伟达的优势地位。

articles.title: 地表最强科技联姻：马斯克称特斯拉与 SpaceX 合并“有很多好处”
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，彭博社今天（10 月 21 日）发布博文，报道称在 2026 财年第三财季（2026 年 7 月～2026 年 9 月）财报电话会上，全球首富埃隆 · 马斯克表示 SpaceX 与特斯拉均已成立由独立董事组成的特别委员会，研究两家公司潜在合并的可能性。若交易最终落地，有望成为有史以来规模最大的企业合并。马斯克称，合并“有很多好处”，尤其是在双方共同开发“超级智能”（SI）软件、推进人工智能与自动驾驶等业务方面，合作空间巨大。不过他强调，目前两家公司的委员会尚未就交易条款达成一致，合并并不确定。由于马斯克同时担任两家公司首席执行官，并持有大量股权，他表示自己属于利益冲突方，不会参与委员会讨论。两家公司董事会是在股东要求下设立特别委员会，以评估交易方案。从程序上看，交易仍面临较高门槛。马斯克表示，特斯拉方面需要获得全体股东中至少 50% 的赞成票。市场对这一消息反应积极，特斯拉股价盘后一度上涨约 1.2%。IT之家附上相关市值和股价截图如下：巴克莱分析师此前曾预计，特斯拉与 SpaceX 的合并可能在特斯拉 12 月年度股东大会前公布，并认为 SpaceX 更有可能成为收购方；但两家公司及马斯克均未正式承诺推进交易。

articles.title: 通用汽车关闭底特律电池组装厂，因租约到期而非电动化战略调整
articles.content: IT之家 10 月 21 日消息，通用汽车（GM）发言人向科技博客 TechCrunch 证实，公司将关闭底特律南部的一处电池组装工厂。布朗斯敦电池组装厂负责为凯迪拉克旗舰电动车型 Celestiq 组装电池包，同时也为雪佛兰科尔维特 E-Ray 生产电驱动单元（也就是车辆的驱动电机）以及电池包，科尔维特 E-Ray 是这款经典跑车的插电混动版本。这名发言人表示，本次关闭工厂和通用汽车的电动汽车战略无关。原因是该厂房为通用租赁，租约即将到期。布朗斯敦工厂的员工与相关生产任务将转移至通用汽车其他厂区，但公司并未确认具体接收单位。和众多车企一样，在《One Big Beautiful Bill Act》生效后，通用汽车的电动化战略遭遇意外挫折。这部去年签署的美国联邦综合性法案取消了电动汽车生产与销售相关补贴。在此之后，通用汽车减少了对外发布的电动汽车相关表态，但并未放弃全面电动化目标。通用汽车仍在生产多款电动汽车，包括雪佛兰 Silverado EV 以及限时复产的雪佛兰 Bolt。公司也在持续研发新型电池化学体系，比如富锂锰基电池与钠离子电池，同时还在推进一座耗资 9 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 60.24 亿元人民币）的新工厂建设，加快相关技术商业化落地。

articles.content: Netflix reported earnings for the third quarter that exceeded Wall Street expectations, but forecast a fourth consecutive quarter of slowing sales growth, a projection that may amplify concerns about the performance of the world’s leading online TV network. Netflix delivered sales of $12.9 billion in the third quarter, in line with Wall Street’s expectations, and forecast sales of $13.4 billion in the year’s final three months, falling short of what analysts have predicted. The company blamed its sales shortfall on the advertising business, which is on pace to deliver $300 million less than the company expected. articles.title: 启元机器人新进展：北大董豪团队推出 HIL-UMI，让后训练摆脱「真机依赖」
articles.content: 继无本体之后，具身后训练范式有了新进展。    作者丨齐铖湧    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       最近，具身行业讨论“无本体进行后训练的可能性”的热度很高。国内外目前还没有团队做出可行方案。说白了，无论是大模型还是具身机器人，想真正好用，光靠预训练打基础可不行，最终落地全靠“后训练”来调教。启元机器人首席科学家董豪告诉AI科技评论：“预训练提升的是下限，上限还得看后训练。”当前具身公司追求进厂打工、家庭保洁等真实落地，比的就是成功率，也就是在比拼后训练的实力。可后训练，难就难在它得跟真实物理世界打交道，过去都得用纯真机数据。但真机训练成本太高，要大规模铺开，那么多的机器人本体，硬件磨损、场地、人工都是天价。所以，行业内预训练已经开始转向用“无本体”设备采集数据，虽然量上去了，但传统后训练最关键的“纠错”环节却没法搞定。为了解决这个行业难题，北大和启元机器人董豪团队推出了HIL-UMI。这个工作，围绕着具身后训练阶段无本体的前提下，围绕着最关键的“纠错”环节展开。论文地址：https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.20659项目主页：https://hil-umi.github.io01具身后训练的成本，为何远超大模型RLHF？跟大模型比起来，具身行业的后训练太贵，是很多具身模型无法尝试Scaling的重要原因。大语言模型能变得这么好用，大家心里都清楚：不光是预训练数据量大，更关键的是后面有RLHF（人类反馈强化学习，可以简单理解为数据标注）和DPO这些“后训练”的功劳。但具身机器人的后训练，成本可比大模型的RLHF高出不止百倍。大模型做RLHF，无非是请更多人坐在电脑前点点选选；可具身机器人，那就得真刀真枪地跟物理世界打交道。拿传统上最常用的DAgger，也就是用人类或者算法作为专家评价后训练的模式，这套流程虽然有效，但又贵又慢。比较常见的，是以传统的真机人在回路（也就是 HG-DAgger：Human-Gated DAgger），机械臂在运作，人类操作员坐在旁边高度紧张地盯着，等它快抓空、快撞车的时候紧急接管，把正确的轨迹录下来，这就是人类来把关整个训练回路。最麻烦的是，每次校正完，还得人工把被碰乱的现场恢复原样。等机器人执行，人工干预，环境复位，一坐一下午，能用的数据不多。这其中绝大部分时间，都耗在机器人的笨拙动作和人工环境复位上。这种又慢又烧钱的模式，让后训练数据规模采集成了个老大难，严重限制了规模化。这就引出了一个核心问题：我们能不能摆脱真机，就像平时做家务一样，顺手就把模型最需要的“纠错”数据给采集了？02HIL-UMI 的底层逻辑：给UMI 采集加了一个“模型大脑”HIL-UMI 的做法非常聪明，概括起来就是一句话：“不用机器人，也能给机器人补课。”HIL-UMI ，指的是Human-In-the-Loop（人在环路）UMI，和过去大家常用 UMI（手持夹爪）采集数据不同，HIL-UMI 的采集，不是“盲目”的，而是加入了一个模型。HIL-UMI 把模型直接接进了这个手持采集过程：真实世界里只有人在动： 操作员手里拿着 UMI 夹爪正常干活（比如抓玩具、叠毛巾），摄像头同步拍摄画面。模型在后台“脑补”： 模型接收着相同的画面和任务指令，在后台快速预测“如果换我来，接下来的 20 步动作该怎么做”，但它并不真正控制任何机械臂。发现分歧立刻触发提示： 系统在后台实时比对人类实际动作与模型预测动作。如果两者差不多，说明模型已经掌握，不需要重复录；一旦发现模型“脑补”的轨迹跟人类的真实操作严重跑偏（说明模型在这个场景下是个“生手”），系统就会立刻提示操作者：“这一段模型不会，从这里开始多教一段！”手持夹爪与采集设备整个过程，不需要机械臂在场，更不需要机器人真去犯一次错。人类在示范的同时，就把模型在真实部署中极可能翻车的场景给定点捕获了。03不是数采集工具，是后训练

articles.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
articles.content: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

articles.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.

articles.title: Can It Actually Work? Synthesizing Functional CAD Mechanisms
articles.content: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.

articles.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
articles.content: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

articles.title: VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token
articles.content: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.

articles.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
articles.content: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

articles.title: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
articles.content: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

articles.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
articles.content: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

articles.title: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
articles.content: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast and scalable navigation decisions in constrained human-shared environments. However, directly extending single-robot approaches to multi-robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, where individual robots may overlook potential risks or make inaccurate predictions. Leveraging cooperation effectively for both prediction and navigation remains a major challenge. We propose CoopUQ, a multi-robot social navigation framework that bridges uncertainty-aware cooperative occupancy forecasting and robust decision making. CoopUQ predicts future occupancy grid maps through cross-robot spatiotemporal feature fusion and further leverages forecasts and their uncertainty to guide policy via constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning, where the cost penalizes navigation through regions predicted to be occupied or highly uncertain. This design enables the policy to adapt its risk sensitivity under distribution shifts. Experimental results across multiple Unity3D-based simulation environments with both in-distribution and OOD settings, including diverse layouts, pedestrian densities, and rushing behavior, demonstrate improved prediction performance and safety over representative baselines. Real-robot experiments further demonstrate its robustness across various scenes. Our code and videos are available at https://coopuq.github.io/.

articles.title: Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning
articles.content: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/

articles.title: GenOlympiad: Benchmarking Frontier Image Models at Their Capability Boundaries
articles.content: Text-to-image models have made tremendous progress and can produce high-quality images. However, a question which would be asked in any other discipline is where the frontier models fall short. We introduce GenOlympiad, a benchmark which provides the most challenging text prompts from nine capability axes for stress-testing frontier text-to-image models. The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/

articles.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
articles.content: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

articles.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
articles.content: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

articles.title: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
articles.content: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

articles.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
articles.content: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

articles.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
articles.content: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

articles.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
articles.content: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.

articles.title: Newton-Based Methods for Bilevel Optimization Beyond Lower-Level Strong Convexity
articles.content: Bilevel optimization provides a framework for machine learning tasks such as hyperparameter optimization, data reweighting, and meta-learning. Existing Newton-based bilevel methods typically rely on the classical hypergradient formula, which is generally unavailable when lower-level solutions are nonunique and the lower-level Hessian is singular. We develop two Newton-based methods beyond lower-level strong convexity by exploiting curvature shared by the lower-level and multiplier updates. Newton-based GALET handles potentially singular lower-level curvature under a positive spectral-gap condition, exploiting its range structure to avoid the squared-Hessian multiplier system used in GALET. Newton-based BAMM uses a strongly convex aggregation model when the lower-level objective is convex and the upper-level objective is strongly convex in the lower-level variable. We establish convergence guarantees and improved complexity bounds relative to GALET and sl-BAMM under the corresponding assumptions. We further introduce GNBO, a generalized Newton-based framework that captures the shared-curvature structure of the proposed methods and several existing Newton and quasi-Newton bilevel methods. Experiments on synthetic problems, data hyper-cleaning, and GPT-2 data reweighting evaluate the proposed methods across different bilevel learning tasks.

articles.title: SpecKCast: Spectral Kalman Forecasting for Diffusion Acceleration
articles.content: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve high-fidelity image and video generation, but they suffer from substantial inference costs due to repeated transformer evaluations across many denoising steps. Feature caching reduces this cost by reusing features across denoising steps. Recent forecasting methods extend this idea by extrapolating features to skipped steps instead of reusing them. However, existing forecasting methods extrapolate the features they predict uniformly, even though the spatial-frequency components of these features change most at different stages of denoising. They also overlook that denoising progresses nonuniformly, so equal step intervals can correspond to very different amounts of change. These mismatches amplify forecast errors as more steps are skipped, limiting the achievable acceleration. We propose SpecKCast, a training-free method that forecasts the model output in the frequency domain. SpecKCast applies a 2D discrete cosine transform (DCT) to the output and tracks each coefficient with a lightweight Kalman filter along a band-specific time coordinate derived from the noise schedule. The filter tracks each coefficient's value and rate of change, and the transformer is evaluated only when the filter's forecast uncertainty exceeds a threshold. Experiments on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image, Wan2.1-14B, and HunyuanVideo show that SpecKCast achieves a better trade-off between acceleration and fidelity than existing caching and forecasting methods, reaching up to 6x speedup with less than 0.05 GiB of additional memory.

articles.title: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
articles.content: LLM agents that compute the right answer can still answer wrongly. Agent harnesses increasingly keep long tool outputs out of the context window, saving them to files that the agent searches or reads on demand. We ask where this costs accuracy with a real scientific tool: PHREEQC, a widely used geochemistry simulator from the USGS, whose reports reach 846.8k characters and whose determinism lets every printed value be traced. Agents use it to answer 158 execution-verified multiple-choice items. When agents read the simulator's report through a section index rather than in context, GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2 lose 11.3 and 7.9 points of accuracy, while Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 show no detectable cost. Re-running all 11,007 logged simulator calls shows that both GPT models compute the keyed value about as often as before; what changes is the evidence they answer from. Under retrieval they often skip the report, answer from their own higher-precision output files, and misround to a neighboring option, a failure we call evidence substitution. With the simulation held fixed, retrieval still costs GPT-5.2 9.4 points. For GPT-5.4, more frequent correct simulations mask an evidence-use loss of about ten points, leaving a net change indistinguishable from zero. Naming the authoritative output raises accuracy by 6.3-7.9 points over plain retrieval for the three GPT models; for GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, inlining outputs that fit works as well, while asking for correct rounding does not. Context-management choices in agent harnesses should be judged by where accuracy is lost, not only by final accuracy.

articles.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
articles.content: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

articles.title: Supervised Learning with Quantum Hamiltonian Embeddings
articles.content: Machine learning is widely regarded as a promising application in which quantum computing could offer a computational advantage. However, general quantum machine learning models with provable guarantees on performance, trainability, and efficient inference remain limited. In this work, we introduce quantum Hamiltonian embeddings, a supervised learning framework in which a classical training dataset is encoded into a single effective, parameterized Hamiltonian. Training optimizes the parameters of this data-dependent Hamiltonian, whose approximate ground state defines the classification rule. Once the ground state has been approximated using a quantum algorithm, inference can be performed either classically using a classical representation of the learned state, or with a quantum representation of the state. We establish efficient methods for gradient estimation and prove favorable generalization guarantees. Furthermore, under standard cryptographic assumptions, we show that Hamiltonian embeddings can realize hypothesis functions beyond the reach of efficient classical algorithms. We then demonstrate the framework at scale on IBM Heron processors using a standard benchmark dataset. Together, these results establish Hamiltonian embeddings as a new framework for quantum machine learning, combining theoretical guarantees with a path for experimental investigations at scale on quantum hardware.

articles.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
articles.content: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.

articles.title: ProteinGeoBench: Frontier Structural-Biology Agents Are Fluent at Lookup but Lost in Geometry
articles.content: Frontier agents retrieve structural metadata well and compute geometry from coordinates less reliably. We ask how much of a benchmark score reflects that gap and how much reflects the evaluation configuration around the model. We study ProteinGeoBench, a suite of 131 protein-structure tasks, using 4,249 rollouts from four frontier models and 4,486 further trials across 26 models. Three of the four frontier models fall within 0.031 of one another (0.785 to 0.816) with no difference between them resolved, while the fourth scores 0.707 and all three gaps to it exclude zero. Three of the four do better on metadata lookup than on numeric calculation. The fourth is slightly better on numeric. Numeric tasks are 28 of the 131 but half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail. The ranking also depends on the evaluation budget: with one run per task, 23.9% of bootstrap replicates put a different model first. On a selected 15-task slice, removing network access lowers scores more than blocking eight structural-database domains, but the two contrasts were graded in different passes and cannot be cleanly decomposed. Swapping in each model's own command-line agent changes scores by -0.071 to +0.086, a comparison too small to rule out moderate harness effects. Across 26 models, numeric performance rises with non-numeric performance rather than staying flat. The experiments use different task subsets, so they cannot rank model, harness, access and task composition against one another. articles.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
articles.content: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

articles.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
articles.content: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.

articles.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
articles.content: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

articles.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
articles.content: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

articles.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
articles.content: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.

articles.title: AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages
articles.content: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.

articles.title: Git 被换掉，LLM 被替代：AI 编码开始反噬传统工具链？
articles.content: Anthropic 代码量暴涨，GitHub 密钥扫描又慢又贵，两家被迫改造系统。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       Git 已经支撑软件开发二十多年，Anthropic 却决定把它换掉。为了让 Claude 持续生成的代码顺利进入开发流程，7 名工程师花了 5 个月，开发出版本控制系统 Scion，并将核心代码仓库迁移过去。今年 5 月，Anthropic 每天平均合并约 2500 项代码变更，到 9 月已超过 3 万项，仅 CI 系统每天就要执行约 2500 万次代码检出。写代码的速度上来了，准备仓库、同步对象和查询历史却越来越费机器。几乎同一时期，GitHub 用微调后的 ModernBERT 替换密钥扫描中的通用 LLM 判断。哥伦比亚大学与 Google DeepMind 等机构则通过 BTTF，把芯片仿真波形转换成 SQLite，让 Agent 使用 SQL 排查异常。Scion 默认在线，BTTF 将波形变成查询接口，GitHub 把高频判断交给分类器。围绕人类开发节奏设计的系统，开始承受 Agent 带来的另一种负载。01Git 的离线能力，为什么成了负担Git 的分布式设计让工程师克隆仓库后，即使断网也能提交、合并、查看历史。但 Anthropic 大量读取代码的任务是始终联网的 CI 作业和 Agent 沙箱，运行几分钟便销毁，可能只需要几个文件、一份 diff，或确认两个提交的祖先关系。为了这些操作准备本地仓库，重复成本越来越高。Anthropic 主分支历史接近 100 GB，压缩工作副本超过 25 GB。若每天 2500 万次检出分别获取完整副本，理论流量会超过 600 PB。公司虽用浅克隆、稀疏检出、快照和数百台 Git 镜像，但镜像仍要同步、快照会过期，历史查询还需补齐对象。仓库越活跃，维护成本越高。Scion 将客户端缩成轻量入口。提交创建、合并、变基与历史查询放到中心服务，本地仅监测文件变化、维护少量缓存，需要工作目录时按需展开。CI 若只想计算 diff，可以直接调用 API，无须完整检出。这牺牲了离线自治，却减少重复初始化。提交格式也变了。Git commit 指向描述仓库状态的目录树，Scion 的 changeset 则以预写日志条目记录相对首个父提交修改过的文件，通过内容寻址指针引用数据。创建 changeset 无须生成 Git packfile，也不用立即移动共享分支，只有 main 等引用更新时，系统才对 Spanner 中的单行记录执行 compare-and-swap。Agent 可以并发生成变更，竞争集中到分支引用移动时。但历史查询仍有难题：增量记录无法直接回答某行是谁改的、文件经历过什么。Scion 为 blame、路径历史与提交图跳表维护 derived data，按父提交关系预计算，或等查询发生后再生成。写入与历史分析可以独立扩展。雷峰网检出时，scn 客户端从目标目录树开始，只请求缺失的 tree 和 blob。请求依次经过节点上的 scion-daemon、区域 scion-cache，再由 scion-server 回源到 Spanner 或对象存储。对象写入后不可变，缓存能够跨任务复用，减少协商、压缩及反复传输。Anthropic 称缓存命中率超过 99%，并限制故障时的回源流量。迁移后，Scion 相较旧 Git 镜像体系的 CPU 和内存需求约缩小 200 倍，检出从分钟级降至秒级，CI 释放约 25% 的 CPU 容量。200 倍说的是基础设施资源占用，并非 Git 操作整体提速。Anthropic 还同步建设 Antique 代码评审、源码搜索、IAM 和批量合并工具，以适配新协议。在线服务的维护也成了新成本。02让数据库读波形，Agent 才能追查故障芯片验证面对的是另一种障碍。

articles.content: 官方承认 3D 短板，跨模型测试 Harness 不同。    作者丨郑佳美    编辑丨岑   峰                                                                                                       Meta 刚发布的 Muse Wonder，没想到因为一盏熔岩灯，在开发者社区引发了一场关于 AI 模型跑分的争论。10 月 12 日，Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 和 Muse Wonder Full，主打 Coding Agent、工具调用和长任务执行能力。官方公布的成绩相当亮眼，Wonder Full 在 SWE-Marathon 上拿到 57.5 分，DeepSWE 1.1 达到 79.0 分，已经能够与同期的前沿模型展开竞争。然而，开发者社区 BridgeMind 随后安排了一项 3D 编程测试，要求 Muse Wonder 制作一盏具有透明玻璃外壳、动态熔岩和光照效果的熔岩灯。结果模型只生成了一个红色圆柱体。BridgeMind 随即质疑 Muse Wonder 存在严重的 Benchmaxxing，也就是针对 Benchmark 进行大量优化，成绩看着漂亮，碰上陌生任务却露了怯。连马斯克也忍不住下场，在相关帖子下意味深长地回了一句 Hmm。短短一个词，虽然没有明确表态，却让这场围绕 Meta 新模型的刷分争议又添了几分戏剧性。Meta 首席 AI 官 Alexandr Wang 很快回应，团队确实没有针对 3D 演示游戏进行显式训练，事后看来或许应该补充相关训练，但他仍然希望开发者实际体验 Muse Wonder 的 Coding 能力。雷峰网这场争论有一个重要前提：熔岩灯测试针对的是普通版 Muse Wonder，而 Meta 公布的部分突出成绩来自 Wonder Full，两者存在能力差异。同时，Meta 官方 Model Card 已经明确承认，视觉与空间推理，尤其是 3D 任务，属于 Muse Wonder 的已知短板。但高分模型在陌生任务中遭遇如此明显的失败，依然让人好奇：当前大模型的训练方法究竟在强化哪些能力，Agent Benchmark 又能在多大程度上反映模型的实际水平？01奖励机制，决定模型擅长解决什么问题Muse Wonder 的表现，与当前大模型越来越依赖 Post-training 提升任务能力的技术路线有关。在 Pre-training 阶段，模型通过大规模数据学习语言、代码、空间关系和其他通用知识。进入 Post-training 后，训练会进一步塑造模型的行为策略，尤其是通过强化学习，让它在特定任务环境中形成更稳定的执行能力。Coding Agent 很适合这类训练。例如，给模型一个存在 Bug 的代码仓库，要求它定位问题、修改文件并运行测试。整个过程可以通过编译结果、单元测试和功能检查获得相对明确的反馈。强化学习系统据此判断哪些操作有效，持续强化能够提高任务成功率的行为。训练规模扩大后，模型逐渐学会一套复杂的软件工程策略，包括如何缩小搜索范围、选择工具、处理报错，以及在多轮修改中维护任务状态。Meta 在官方技术文章中提到，Muse Wonder 接受了多样化长任务训练，并引入 Active Focus，使模型能够在遭遇阻碍后尝试其他方案、恢复执行并继续推进任务。但这类训练依赖一个关键条件：环境必须能够向模型提供有用的反馈。熔岩灯恰好打破了传统 Coding Agent 熟悉的反馈方式。雷峰网从程序实现来看，熔岩灯涉及三维几何、透明材质、光照计算和动态形变。如果使用 Three.js，模型需要构造玻璃灯罩，为内部熔岩生成不规则的几何形态，再通过时间变量或噪声函数驱动形状变化。这些代码即使能够正常执行，画面仍然可能完全错误。例如，透明材质的参数配置不当，玻璃就可能变成不透明的实体，熔岩形状缺少连续变化机制，内部效果就可能退化为静态色块。编译器和单元测试很难直接判断这些视觉问题。这意味着，Agent 还需要具备一套
